title: Virtuala
tagline: A Property marketplace on the blockchain, to trade properties.
description: This project seeks to create a marketplace where apartments are listed as tokens and can be purchased by interested owners. Users can log into their accounts and either choose to list the properties or buy those properties. Then they can look through the properties and choose the one they want.
how_its_made: I used Next.js and React to create an interactive website where the properties are listed and shown. Alongside Tailwind-css to create an intuitive design, which showcases the property page. I then used Solidity to create my smart contract, alongside the ethers.js library. I then also use Hardhat as a means for testing my contract and deploying it.
